draft.body:
## 董事会贴现率会议纪要

## 1
2026年8月17日、9月9日和9月16日董事会贴现率会议记录。 [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

周二，Federal Reserve Board发布了最近会议的纪要，以审查并确定通过贴现窗口向存款机构提供的贴现率。 [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

## 2
今天的会议纪要涵盖了2026年8月17日、9月9日和9月16日的董事会会议。 [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

## 3
制定贴现率的流程与Federal Open Market Committee设定联邦基金利率目标范围的流程不同。 [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

## 4
媒体咨询，请发送电子邮件至 [email protected] 或拨打 202-452-2955。 [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

2026-10-26

outline.original_body:
Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

The Federal Reserve Board issued the meeting minutes on Tuesday to review and decide on the discount rates offered to depository institutions via the discount window. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]
The minutes from today cover the Board meetings that took place on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

The process used by the Board to set the discount rate is different from the process followed by Federal Open Market Committee in setting the target range for the federal funds rate. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]
For media inquiries, please email [email protected] or call 202-452-2955. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

Today's minutes cover the Board meetings that occurred on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026.
The Board's process for setting the discount rate is distinct from the process the Federal Open Market Committee follows in setting the target range for the federal funds rate.
For media inquiries, please email [email protected] or call 202-452-2955.
